name: markproof
description: Watermark and C2PA-sign AI-generated images and audio for EU AI Act Article 50, and verify files.
long_description: Lets AI agents mark the images and audio they generate, as the EU AI Act's Article 50 requires: an invisible watermark (TrustMark for images, AudioSeal for audio) plus a signed C2PA manifest (Content Credentials), in one tool call. Verify any file's watermark and C2PA signature, by path or URL. Files are processed in the EU. 250 free calls a month.

api_key.title: Markproof API key
api_key.description: From markproof.co/dashboard (250 free calls a month).

tools.name: mark_file
tools.description: Watermark and C2PA-sign a local image or audio file; writes <name>.marked.png/.wav beside it.

tools.name: verify_file
tools.description: Check a file (by path or URL) for a Markproof watermark and a C2PA manifest.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Look up a file you marked by its asset id.
